categories.name: hdl-communications
categories.description: HDL-optimized communications blocks for FPGA and ASIC implementation

customDescriptions.value: HDL-optimized communications filters (raised cosine, CIC, FIR) for FPGA implementation — use for pulse shaping and matched filtering in hardware-targeted receiver/transmitter designs
HDL-compatible signal analysis and measurement blocks — use to capture and analyze communications signals within HDL-targeted subsystems
HDL-optimized signal generators (NCO, PN sequence, test patterns) for FPGA — use to generate reference signals and test data in hardware-targeted designs
HDL-optimized FEC encoders and decoders (Viterbi, RS, LDPC, turbo) for FPGA — use to implement channel coding in hardware with streaming interfaces and fixed latency
HDL-optimized interleavers and deinterleavers for FPGA — use to implement bit/symbol reordering in hardware with deterministic throughput and memory-efficient architectures
HDL-optimized modulators and demodulators (QAM, PSK, OFDM) for FPGA — use to implement physical-layer modulation in hardware with fixed-point arithmetic and pipeline-friendly architectures
